OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for space missions in, for example, communication, earth observation and space research for institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe.
Building a satellite requires a broad range of expertise, involving the analysis, design, manufacturing, and testing of both hardware and software. At OHB Sweden, we offer engineers an exceptional opportunity to expand their technical skills across all domains.
We are seeking a skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer with space experience in the complete chain from CAD mechanical design, FEM analysis, and generation of production drawings to follow-on testing of the manufactured product.
Collaborating with external partners (customers, payload suppliers, etc.) to define and implement mechanical interfaces will be an integral part of your daily responsibilities. 
What We’re Looking For:

A structured, motivated, mechanical design engineer with proven leadership abilities.

Ability to work independently while meeting agreed delivery schedules.

Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

Ability to plan and drive the success of our projects.

If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of space technology and eager to contribute to innovative satellite projects, we would love to hear from you!
If you wish to have an active role in the development of future space systems, feel confident that your experience and qualifications match the above requirements and want to find yourself in a dynamic and inspiring work environment, then we very much look forward to hearing from you! 
Task Description:

Having a lead role on design of mechanical, structural, and dynamic components using CAD and FEM, focusing on stress, shock, and random vibration analyses.

Oversee the generation of manufacturing drawings from CAD models, using GPS tolerancing.

Lead technical discussions with customers and suppliers.

Supervise off-site manufacturing of parts and inspect delivered items.

Support on-site assembly of end products, such as spacecraft structures.

Define and design test specifications, procedures, and setups for subsystem qualification (structures, mechanisms, units, components, actuators).

Correlate FE models (e.g., fundamental frequencies, damping coefficients) with actual test results.

Assist in planning and budgeting for future programs and projects.

Design, assemble, and test mechanical ground support equipment (MGSE) for integration and test activities.

Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance within the team. 

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Space Engineering, or related disciplines.

Minimum of 7 years of experience in design and testing environments related to CAD, mechanical FEM analysis, and design.

Proven ability to lead and inspire teams and/or groups, driving projects forward.

Experience within ESA projects.

Good knowledge of the ECSS.

Expertise with CREO, Catia, NX, or similar. CREO is the tool we use.

Proficiency in FEM analysis, particularly in random vibration response, shock, and loads analysis.

Ability to generate, read, and understand mechanical design/analysis reports and Interface Control Documents (ICDs).

Clear and coherent reporting and presentation skills in English.

Experience in design-to-manufacture processes.

Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Located in or willing to relocate to Stockholm, Sweden.

 Added Advantageous Qualifications:

Experience in writing test procedures for vibration and shock.

Experience in requirements management and verification.

Proficiency with NASTRAN/Altair

Experience with CREO and/or NX (CAD) and Windchill PLM.

Experience working closely with production/MAIT.

Experience in GPS (Geometric Product Specifications) drawing production.

Knowledge of the European Cooperation for Space Standardization (ECSS) and experience in the space industry.

 Why Join Us?
Join us and work in a dynamic, international environment with exciting collaborations across Europe, while developing your technical expertise from mechanical design to system engineering. Be part of a dedicated team of specialists in systems, electrical, thermal, and AIT, contributing to the development of cutting-edge satellites. You’ll also take ownership of customer and supplier relations, gaining valuable experience in project management and high-level networking.
If you feel confident that you meet the above requirements, then we are looking forward to hearing from you! 🛰️

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Application Security Engineer to become a founding member of our security team. You will be joining a highly regulated iGaming environment where uptime, data integrity, and user trust are paramount.
You will shape the security of our consumer-facing platforms and of the cloud infrastructure they run on, balancing compliance requirements with the agility our business needs to grow.
Why Join Us?
Impact: Be a founding member of the security team, helping shape our application security practice and tooling from the ground up.

High-Stakes Challenge: Work in an environment where security directly affects user trust, real-time operations, and the bottom line.

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
Secure the Development Lifecycle: Embed security into every stage of how we build software, from threat modeling at design time to security review before release. Partner with engineering to make secure-by-default the path of least resistance.

Audit Web & Native Applications: Drive and run security testing and code review across our web and mobile apps.
Protect the API Surface: Review and harden the APIs powering our platforms with focus on authorization and abuse prevention.
Defend the Perimeter: Manage and tune our WAF and DDoS mitigation. You understand that in our industry, availability is revenue.
Secure Cloud Infrastructure: Help harden our cloud environment where it matters most for application security.
Automation & Scripting: Automate security checks, reduce manual toil, and ensure consistent controls across our pipelines and environments.
Compliance Support: Act as the technical bridge for regulatory and ISO certifications.
Business Partnership: Work closely with engineering and product teams. You will champion a "Security by Design" culture, helping stakeholders understand risk without acting as a blocker to innovation.
Strategic partnership: Driving our collaboration with Google to architect the future of our AI workflows and security frameworks.

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
AppSec Specialist: You have a strong background in securing high-scale, consumer-facing applications across mobile and web. You know the OWASP Top 10 cold and have opinions about what it leaves out.

Code Reviewer: You can read and audit code in modern high-level languages and use automated tools.
Networking Native: You have a deep, foundational understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS). You aren't just a cloud user; you understand how packets move and how to secure them at the protocol level.
Cloud-Comfortable: You have working knowledge of cloud security, Kubernetes, and the trade-offs of running microservices at scale.
Regulated Background: You have thrived in industries with strict compliance requirements (iGaming, Fintech or Healthcare) and understand the rigor required.
Scripting Skills: You automate security workflows with Python or similar.
Pragmatic Communicator: You weigh business goals against security risk and can explain to non-technical stakeholders why a control matters.
Provider Management: Experience evaluating, onboarding, and managing external security vendors or managed service providers. You know how to get real value out of third-party partners.

WHO WE ARE
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
BENEFITS
Hybrid work policy

4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
1,500 SEK equipment allowance
Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

🌐 Senior Cisco Networking Consultant
Are you an experienced networking specialist with deep expertise in Cisco, Routing & Switching? We are looking for a Senior Cisco Networking Consultant who wants to work with advanced network environments, combining hands-on technical expertise with architecture, advisory responsibilities, and close customer collaboration.
You will work across technically complex environments where you are trusted to take ownership, solve challenging network issues, and help customers design secure, scalable, and high-performing network solutions.
🚀 About the Role
As a Senior Cisco Networking Consultant, you will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor within Cisco Networking and Routing & Switching.
You will work in different customer environments and be involved throughout the technical lifecycle – from advisory, architecture, and design to implementation, configuration, optimization, and further development.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining deep technical expertise with customer interaction and wants to take an active role in shaping complex networking solutions.
💻 Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:

Act as a technical expert within Cisco Networking, Routing & Switching

Design and architect complex Cisco network environments

Advise customers on network architecture and technical solutions

Install, configure, optimize, and develop network environments

Work with SD-WAN

Work with infrastructure security, including firewalls

Identify and resolve complex network issues

Lead technical workshops and presentations with customers

Independently manage technical tasks and deliveries

Collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

🎯 Who We Are Looking For
You are an experienced networking professional who enjoys working in a customer-facing and consultative environment. You are confident in your technical expertise and comfortable taking ownership of complex technical challenges.
You are proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently without constant supervision. You also have strong communication skills and can explain complex technical solutions clearly to both technical specialists and non-technical stakeholders.
As the role involves close collaboration with customers in Sweden, you must be able to communicate in Swedish at a conversational level or higher. Fluency in Swedish is highly valued. You must also be fluent in English.
✅ Requirements
5+ years of experience within Networking and Routing & Switching, with a strong focus on Cisco

Hands-on professional experience with Cisco Networks

Experience designing and architecting Cisco network environments

Experience with infrastructure security, including firewalls

Experience with SD-WAN

Ability to work independently and proactively in complex technical environments

Comfortable working directly with customers and in customer environments

Swedish at a conversational level  – mandatory

Fluent English – mandatory

⭐ Nice to Have
Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CCNP Security or CCIE

University degree within IT, networking, engineering, or a related field

Previous experience working as a consultant

Experience leading workshops and technical presentations

Advanced experience with network architecture and complex enterprise environments

🔎 Recruitment Process
The recruitment process includes several interview stages where both your technical expertise and consulting capabilities will be assessed. You will also have the opportunity to meet technical specialists and gain a deeper understanding of the role and working environment.
The process concludes with a reference check.
📍 Location: Stockholm 🏠 Work model: Hybrid, including work in customer environments 📅 Start date: October 15, 2026

Develop and maintain the Scheduling Management Plan, standards, and procedures.

Advanced English.
